# Jerky Fixx

> Jerky Fixx (jerkyfixx.com) is a family run, small batch beef jerky and carne seca business in Albuquerque, New Mexico, owned by Joseph Garduno and Sabrina Penn Garduno. The name is spelled Jerky Fixx, with two Xs (sometimes searched as "Jerky Fix" or "jerkyfixx").

## Key facts
- What: small batch beef jerky and carne seca in 25 flavors, including X-Hot Green, Green, Red, X-Mas, Hot Cheetos, Takis, Mango Habanero, Garlic Parm, Honey Teriyaki, Lemon Pepper and Tajin Limon.
- Where: Albuquerque and Rio Rancho, New Mexico. Sold at pop ups, festivals and ball games, with door drop off delivery (the dealer sends a photo when the order is delivered).
- Prices: small bag $7, large bag $20. Payment: Cash App, Venmo, Apple Pay or cash.
- Awards: Most Exotic Flavor and Best Booth at New Mexico Jerky Fest.
- People: owners Joseph Garduno and Sabrina Penn Garduno; their daughter Aaliyah Garduno manages the website and writes the Fixx Blog.
- Contact: 505-922-5683, 505-364-0678, jerkyfixx@gmail.com. Instagram @jerky_fixx, facebook.com/jerky.fixx, Threads @jerky_fixx.
